item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Confirm and freeze the exact selected scope","mechanism":"Separate the 25 visible rows from all matching records; confirmation freezes membership rather than a live filter.","implementation":"Provide keyboard-accessible scope choices. Resolve explicit IDs before confirmation; show actual count, filter summary, and target status persistently afterward.","check":"Confirm 600 IDs, then change filters and matching records; assert every submitted ID belongs to that confirmed set.","risk":"Membership resolution can become stale; require reconfirmation for additions."},{"action":"Skip records changed since scope confirmation","mechanism":"Conditional writes detect intervening edits instead of silently overwriting another person's changes.","implementation":"Capture record revisions alongside confirmed IDs. In the bulk handler, atomically compare each revision before updating; return conflicts as per-record outcomes.","check":"Modify a record after confirmation but before its write; verify it remains untouched and receives a readable conflict outcome.","risk":"Revision checks require backend work and may increase conflicts."},{"action":"Recover failures through a per-record operation ledger","mechanism":"Persisted outcomes separate successes, failures, and unresolved requests so recovery does not repeat successful writes.","implementation":"Store confirmed IDs under an operation key. Deduplicate writes by operation and ID; offer keyboard-accessible failed-only retry and polite screen-reader progress announcements.","check":"Interrupt a mixed-result batch, reopen it, and retry; verify successful IDs are not rewritten and unconfirmed IDs never appear.","risk":"Unknown outcomes need reconciliation; conflicts need review rather than blind retry."},{"action":"Explain reversal eligibility for each changed record","mechanism":"A timed, revision-checked reversal distinguishes expiration from subsequent edits and unsuccessful original changes.","implementation":"Store prior status, resulting revision, and policy deadline per success. Provide accessible eligibility reasons; atomically check deadline and revision when reversing explicit original IDs.","check":"Test unchanged, subsequently edited, expired, and originally failed records; verify only eligible records reverse and each rejection states why.","risk":"Eligibility can change after display; refresh reasons after attempted reversal."}],"abstention_reason":""}
